headline: This law renames two NASA facilities in California, swapping the names of the Dryden Flight Research Center and the Western Aeronautical Test Range.
what_it_does: The law changes the official names of two NASA sites in California. The Dryden Flight Research Center in Edwards becomes the Neil A. Armstrong Flight Research Center. The Western Aeronautical Test Range becomes the Hugh L. Dryden Aeronautical Test Range. The summary does not describe any change to funding, staffing, or operations.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on January 16, 2014.
